(V)accination (T)imeliness Inconsistent Records Plot

Source: R/vt_inconsistent_plot.R
vt_inconsistent_plot.Rd

Generates a lollipop plot showing the distribution of untimely records, grouping them in bins of days outside of the timeliness window. The UNTIMELY_LATE records and the UNTIMELY_EARLY records are shown in separate rows.

Usage

vt_inconsistent_plot(
  data.EIR,
  data.schedule,
  vaccines = NULL,
  birth_cohorts = NULL,
  day_groups = list(c(0, 10), c(10, 20), c(20, 30), c(30, 40), c(40, 50), c(50, 60),
    c(60, 70), c(70, 80), c(80, 90), c(90, 100))
)

Arguments

data.EIR

Data frame. A data frame containing individual vaccination records. See immunABC.EIR for expected structure.

data.schedule

Data frame. A data frame defining the vaccination schedule. See immunABC.schedule for expected structure.

vaccines

Character (optional). A character vector specifying the doses to include in the analysis. If NULL (default), all doses in data.schedule are included and pooled together.

birth_cohorts

Numeric (optional). A vector specifying the birth cohort(s) to include in the plot. If NULL (default), all available cohorts are used. Note that specifying cohorts excludes records with no date_birth, so the DATE_MISSING category may be undercounted.

day_groups

List of numeric vectors of length 2. Each element is a c(lower, upper) pair defining each bin's lower and upper limit in days. Bins must start at 0 and be contiguous (each bin starts where the previous one ends). The last bin is extended to Inf, so its upper value is ignored (e.g. c(90, 120) and c(90, 100) both produce a "90+" bin). Default is 10-day bins from 0 to 100.

Value

A ggplot object representing the lollipop plot.
